title: LP1 square: dictionary candidate space for the selected phrase
question: How many words in a pinned crib corpus fit the four reported GP totals and rune lengths before a meaningful phrase is selected?
summary: A 138,466-row pinned corpus has 38, 15, 10 and 38 candidates for the four fixed slots, yielding 216,600 ordered combinations before grammar or meaning is considered.

scope.representation: Sixteen preserved CSV files from the pinned 1_grams-full directory, one word per row, original rune strings and GP totals; the source J glyph ᛂ is assigned the same 37 value as manuscript ᛄ.
scope.procedure: Hash-check all inputs, verify each row GP sum from its rune symbols, count all corpus words at totals 131, 151 and 809 and at the four fixed target lengths, then multiply ordered slot counts and draw complete-count-derived histograms.
scope.parameters: 138,466 unique rows across 16 files; targets 131/5, 151/7, 151/4, 131/5; additional 809 census; no frequency weighting; figure displays sums 80–220 while result stores all totals.
scope.exclusions: The historical worddata.csv attachment, alternative rune segmentations, semantic or grammatical scoring, dictionary expansion, a phrase-generation search, any LP2 key operation and statistical inference about author intent.

finding: The four fixed slots admit 38, 15, 10 and 38 corpus entries; their ordered product is 216,600, or 210,900 if the two GP-131 words must differ. Every printed corpus GP total verifies after the disclosed J-glyph mapping.
limitations: This surviving GPL corpus is not established as the exact historical worddata.csv. Ordered products count many nonsentences and do not estimate chance discovery. Vocabulary and stored rune segmentation are corpus-specific; no unsolved-page decoding was tested. Human review pending.
next_steps: Identify the historical CSV or record its absence, then predeclare phrase-generation, grammar scoring and matched controls. Test any selected words as cipher keys only with a fixed transform and held-out target.

family.title: Word-sum candidate-space controls
family.question: How many alternate words or phrases can satisfy fixed rune-sum targets under a declared corpus and representation?

review.reviewer: Codex; full-row GP verification and separate census checker; no independent human review

reproduction.environment: Python 3.9+ standard library; all GPL-3.0 corpus CSVs are included in the standalone ZIP. No network or AI is used during replay.
